paragraphs: In Sukkah 48b there are two sectarians, one named Sasson and the other Simcha, in R' Abbahu’s time; see there.[^1]

notes.text: תרי מיני means two sectarians, not two kinds; Sasson and Simcha are their personal names here, rather than lexical joy headings. מח: gives Sukkah 48b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification. ע״ש means see there. Abbahu’s abbreviated title remains R'.
